name: umka-tut
description: learning Umka language and slowly increasing the program complexity

paragraphs: This repository contains 49 small Umka exercises covering core language constructs, structs, dynamic arrays, maps, interfaces, type switches, coroutine fibers, standard library file I/O, linear algebra (mat.um), functional programming (fnc.um), Unicode decoding (utf8.um), heap/weak pointers, recursive-descent lexers/parsers, binary packet serialization/checksums, publish/subscribe event dispatchers, finite state machines (FSM), binary min-heaps, CSV tabular parsers, AST evaluators, prefix tries, LRU caches, lossless RLE compressors, circular ring buffers, Markdown-to-HTML compilers, Dijkstra…
